<!-- /region -->
<!-- region: kind=transcribed_text question_id=Q1 conf=0.91 state=present is_untrusted_content=1 -->

lights the lamp.
<!-- /region -->
<!-- region: kind=transcribed_text conf=0.99 is_untrusted_content=1 -->

<!-- /region -->
<!-- region: kind=transcribed_text question_id=Q2 conf=0.89 state=present is_untrusted_content=1 -->
Someone might still need the light. A small fishing boat came out of the dark on a stor
night and used the light to find the safe channel, even though the big ships had stoppe
coming.
<!-- /region -->
<!-- region: kind=transcribed_text conf=0.99 is_untrusted_content=1 -->
Q3. Write two or three sentences about how Tomas changes by the end of the passage.
<!-- /region -->

At first Tomas is not sure the lamp matters because no big ships come. After he helps t
fisherman he is sure it does, and he climbs the steps a little taller than before.
<!-- /region -->
